title.en: Restore anonymous Sprint step and timer continuity
title.zh: 恢复匿名今日速成步骤与计时连续性

purpose.en: Fix the production regression where an anonymous learner could answer a Sprint vocabulary item, continue to the next item, then reload and be returned to vocabulary 1/5 with a near-reset timer.
purpose.zh: 修复生产回归：匿名学员完成今日速成词汇题并继续到下一题后，刷新却返回词汇 1/5 且计时器接近重置。

en: Resume a matching anonymous Sprint from its server-managed HttpOnly feature cookie, including round, stage, word, answers, and remaining time.
Treat a new selection from Play as a fresh Sprint, then remove the one-use fresh marker so reloading the same Sprint URL resumes instead of resets.
Persist a vocabulary Continue transition before showing the next item, eliminating the delayed-checkpoint reload race.
zh: 从服务器管理的 HttpOnly 功能 Cookie 恢复匹配的匿名今日速成，包括回合、阶段、单词、答案及剩余时间。
从 Play 新选择时创建全新 Sprint，随后移除一次性 fresh 标记，使同一 Sprint URL 刷新时续学而非重置。
在显示下一词汇题前保存 Continue 转换，消除延迟 checkpoint 与立即刷新的竞态。

en: Anonymous Today's Sprint start, checkpoint, vocabulary Continue, reload, and timer behavior on smartlingo.net only.
Signed-in Sprint remains D1-backed. No Clerk, payment, college, community, AI-provider, sibling-site, or cloud-binding behavior changes.
zh: 仅影响 smartlingo.net 匿名今日速成的开始、checkpoint、词汇 Continue、刷新和计时行为。
登录用户 Sprint 继续由 D1 保存；不修改 Clerk、支付、学院、社区、AI 提供商、兄弟站点或云绑定。

en: Add strict cookie parsing, feature/day/language/duration matching, bounded state restoration, two-hour expiry, and elapsed-time reconciliation.
Send complete Sprint identity with every anonymous checkpoint while keeping all anonymous learning state out of D1.
Add behavioral regression coverage for matching resume, timer continuity, feature/day isolation, malformed-cookie rejection, fresh Play entry, and synchronous Continue persistence.
zh: 新增严格 Cookie 解析、功能/日期/语言/时长匹配、有界状态恢复、两小时过期及已流逝时间校准。
每次匿名 checkpoint 均携带完整 Sprint 身份，同时继续禁止匿名学习状态写入 D1。
新增行为回归测试，覆盖匹配续学、计时连续性、功能/日期隔离、损坏 Cookie 拒绝、Play 新进入及同步 Continue 保存。

en: Run the focused Sprint contracts, complete repository tests, TypeScript, D1 migration validation, production-equivalent build, sensitive-data scan, changed-file lint, artifact/whitespace checks, and shared policy/architecture/base-feature/contracts gates.

Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then have Terra repeat the exact anonymous Chinese-interface English Day 1 ten-minute vocabulary answer, Continue, reload, and timer-resume flow in production.
zh: 执行 Sprint 专项合同、全仓测试、TypeScript、D1 迁移验证、生产等价构建、敏感信息扫描、修改文件 lint、产物/空白检查及共享政策/架构/基础功能/合同门禁。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 发布至 Cloudflare，再由 Terra 在生产环境复测精确流程：中文界面、英语、第 1 天、10 分钟、词汇答题、Continue、刷新及计时续接。

en: No functional scope is intentionally deferred. Repeat After Me remains off during the no-microphone acceptance flow.
zh: 没有功能范围被有意延期；无麦克风验收期间三次跟读继续保持关闭。

en: Preserve SmartLingo's rule that entering from Play starts a new anonymous Sprint while a reload of that selected Sprint resumes its isolated cookie state.
Preserve user-authored untracked files and the existing GitHub Actions to Cloudflare delivery boundary.
zh: 保持 SmartLingo 规则：从 Play 进入会开始新的匿名 Sprint，而刷新已选择的 Sprint 会恢复其隔离 Cookie 状态。
保留用户未跟踪文件及既有 GitHub Actions 至 Cloudflare 发布边界。
